visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Products Instead of Sums
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The rows should be [1], [1,1], [1,2,1] and so on, but every row contains only ones.

solution.explanation: Each inner number is the sum of the two numbers above it. Multiplying 1 by 1 gives 1 again, so every row consists of ones.
